signUp.title: Create your Saqina Dev account
signUp.terms: By creating an account you agree to the <terms>Terms</terms> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
signUp.checkEmailBody: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it to finish creating your account.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.body: Enter the email you signed up with. If an account exists, we will send a reset link.
forgot.sentBody: If an account exists for {email}, a reset link is on its way. The link expires in one hour.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.doneBody: Your password has been changed and other sessions were signed out.
reset.invalidTitle: This link is no longer valid
reset.invalidBody: Reset links expire after one hour and work once. Request a new one.

verify.title: Confirm your email
verify.body: Open the link we emailed you to activate your account. It may take a minute to arrive.
verify.resent: A new link is on its way.
verify.invalidTitle: This verification link is no longer valid
verify.invalidBody: Sign in to receive a new verification link.

notices.sessionExpired: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
notices.continueTo: Sign in to continue to your project.

errors.emailNotVerified: Confirm your email before signing in. We can send the link again.
errors.userExists: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.network: We couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.oauth: Google sign-in did not complete. Try again or use email.
